'''Shield Generator Station 14''' was the fourteenth of the sixteen [[Planetary shield/Legends|planetary shield]] generators that protected the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Caamas/Legends|Caamas]]. Although many of the generators were destroyed during the [[Caamas Firestorm]] by [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] operatives, Shield Generator Station 14 remained intact.<ref name="CatCW" />
